parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is in the domain (business) layer, and most of it is genuine domain behaviour: the service-interval constant, serviceDue(), takeOutOfService() and returnToService() all belong there. The problem is that the class also maps itself to the database. The TypeORM decorators @Entity() on the class and @Column() on the plate field describe how the class is stored. That is persistence work, which belongs to the infrastructure kind (src/persistence/**). Whether the import of 'typeorm' is allowed is a separate rule, checked by other tools, so it isn't judged here. The decorators themselves are the misplaced responsibility.
